concept: To Make a Mixture from Two Mixtures
question: In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of rices costing Rs. 28/kg and Rs. 35/kg respectively so as to get mixture of Rs. 30.5/kg.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of 1st variety of rice = Rs. 28/kg

Cost of 2nd variety of rice = Rs. 35/kg

Cost of mixture = Rs. 30.5/kg

**Concept Used:**

If two ingredients A and B of price x and y respectively are mixed, then the price of resultant mixture is M(mean price). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b2a362a1052a975bb9f4d9e97f7cdb151531049b667bf5f5cf4f1447b31f65c.png] 

Thus the required ratio is:

R = (y~-~M)/(M~-~x)=(M~-~y)/(x~-~M)

Calculation:

By using allegation method,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2f9bde70491221c41e291534d7a89fe35f7c97fc72a80ef6c5772cfce6331ce.png] 

**∴ The required ratio is 9 : 5.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__**When using Mixture and Allegation, take two ingredients in such a way that first ingredient is lower than the mean value and the other one is higher than the mean value.
